definitions.gloss: enclosure; enclosing (in an envelope or package)
definitions.explanation: The act of including a document or item inside an envelope or package along with the main letter or contents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同封|どうふう}⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
{返信用|へんしんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同封|どうふう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I am enclosing a return envelope.

examples.japanese: {同封|どうふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{同封|どうふう} is composed of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (together, same) and {封|ふう} (seal, envelope). It is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {同封|どうふう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enclose).

This word is primarily used in formal correspondence, both written letters and business communications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同封|どうふう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enclose)
- {同封|どうふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (the enclosed documents)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同封|どうふう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ (I am enclosing... — polite business form)
